concerns.text: Telemetry log repository injection and service methods could be extracted into a dedicated telemetry domain package for cleaner modularity.

verdicts.criticalReason: PR #1 (PR #307) violates the explicit CROSS-EPIC RESOURCE GUARD: '.github/workflows/ci.yml, Dockerfile.backend, docker-compose.yml already exist and are owned by other work in this project - do not recreate or rewrite them.' The PR re-creates/overwrites root docker-compose.yml.

concerns.text: AccessibilityPlaywright tests use hardcoded wait timeouts in several places; consider using Playwright auto-waiting locators or state assertions instead.
Deletion test coverage verifies controller and service levels but could be expanded with explicit multi-table relational cascading checks.
The SQL verification test directly queries raw tables; abstracts could be provided in repository methods for long-term maintainability.
E2E acceptance flow test suite can be expanded to cover additional edge case routes.
The test cleanup systematically truncates the sparks table prior to assertions, which is sufficient but could benefit from isolated test database transactions.
E2E client intake verification test uses mock HTTP servers which could be unified with test containers in future iterations.
VaultIntakeView component uses internal styling classes that could be consolidated into docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md utility classes.
Flyway migration for publication schedules creates string representation for platform enum instead of PostgreSQL native enum type.
PodcastPlayerView seeking logic uses HTML5 audio currentTime directly; consider wrapping media controls in an abstracted audio service hook.
CanonReaderView renders markdown HTML directly; ensure sanitized HTML bindings are strictly enforced on user-generated inputs.
CanonReaderView duplicate slice implementation could be unified with PR #11 into a single canonical component.
VaultIntakeView form validation error messages could be localized or centralized in a shared i18n file.

verdicts.criticalReason: PR #14 (PR #317) is missing required source code and tests. The PR contains only design check screenshots in .eneik/records without any Svelte components, JS/TS logic, or unit/E2E test implementations for the Consent Banner feature.
